unify_arch_def: unify an FBNetV2 architecture definition by expanding block tuples into structured dicts with stage and block indices
count_stride_each_block: count the stride of each individual block in a unified architecture definition and return a list
count_strides: compute the cumulative product of all strides across blocks in a unified architecture definition
get_num_stages: get the total number of stages in a unified architecture block list
get_stages_dim_out: get the output channel dimensions for each stage in a unified architecture block list
